Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing law libraries to deliver services on-line.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to law libraries; and adding a new section tochapter 27.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 27.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All of the services of any county or regional law library underthis chapter may be delivered through one or more online electroniclegal research facilities supplied or contracted for by a county orcounties. (2) No county is required to provide law library services in anymanner other than that authorized in subsection (1) of this section. (3) No county may maintain more than one library facility withlegal research materials in the form of printed material, including butnot limited to books, periodicals, or reports. Any county thatmaintains such a facility may also maintain one or more separateelectronic research facilities.
